purpose: Eight separate body references plus experimental shape prior for one SPAR3D correction round

pointcloud.method: approximate robust visual hull; uniform height and estimated head-axis alignment; farthest point sample
limitations: Tail/frill shapes vary slightly by view
Shape prior only; no rig or deformation proof

prompts.anchor:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TABI full-body reference for a reusable 3D character, draft turnaround anchor.
Input images: Image 1 is the authoritative TABI character profile, including its front/side/back designs. Image 2 is a supporting identity and outfit reference, not the desired walking pose.
Primary request: create ONE standalone, full-body FRONT THREE-QUARTER view of exactly this TABI, facing slightly toward the viewer's right, showing clear head and torso depth. Translate the existing design into a softly shaded, solid three-dimensional stylized character without redesigning him.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background, native alpha; no floor or cast shadow.
Subject invariants: large round lavender-pink axolotl head, large warm dark-brown eyes, tiny calm smile, pink cheeks, gold four-point forehead star and tiny golden freckles; pink feathery external gills attached naturally at both sides of the head, behind the headphones; pink/coral headphone band and round dark-plum earcups; short cozy body in an emerald-green coat with golden leopard-print collar, cuffs, front trim and hem; small lavender bare paws and feet; a single broad curved lavender tail with gold freckles, visibly attached at the lower back, curving toward the character's right (viewer left in front view), as in the reference.
Pose: neutral symmetrical standing, both feet flat and slightly apart, head upright; arms relaxed a little away from the torso so the paws, cuffs and sleeves are separate readable forms. No walking, no pockets hiding the paws. Preserve the large-head/short-body proportions.
Style: polished soft 3D character study, matte plush-like surfaces, gentle studio shading revealing genuine volume rather than flat printed outlines. Head has a rounded back, torso has chest-to-back depth, limbs and gills are solid connected forms. Preserve the charm and exact color palette of the original.
Composition: one character only, centered in a square canvas, full body including every gill tip, tail and foot, 12% transparent margin. Camera at mid-body height, long lens with minimal perspective, no top-down view. Neutral even light.
Avoid: multiple views, contact sheets, captions, props, scenery, bases, floating disconnected parts, extra limbs, extra tails, realistic human anatomy, flattened cardboard body, a visible neck gap or clipping.

first_views.view: VIEW: exact straight-on FRONT, yaw 0 degrees. Both eyes, both headphones, both arms and both feet appear symmetrically. Tail remains on viewer LEFT and attaches behind the coat.
